data.title: State-Criminal Shared Infrastructure Overlap
data.description: Detect when IP addresses, nameservers, or hosting infrastructure previously attributed to state-sponsored threat actors begin hosting domains or services associated with criminal campaigns (or vice versa). Uses graph-based detection to identify shared IP CIDR blocks, nameserver overlap, and temporal proximity of domain registrations. State-criminal convergence represents an emerging threat where nation-state infrastructure is repurposed for financially motivated crime, or criminal bulletproof hosting serves dual-use purposes for both espionage and fraud operations. This detection correlates threat intelligence attribution data with passive DNS records and infrastructure registration metadata to surface shared hosting patterns across historically distinct threat actor categories.

enrichment_required.source: Infrastructure correlation enrichment (shared CIDR overlap detection)

falsepositives: Shared hosting providers with both state-actor and criminal clients
CDN/cloud infrastructure serving diverse customer bases
